name: Cable Assembly
old_description: Founded in 1988, Cable Assembly serves major multinational customers, including a number of Fortune 500 companies, from its ISO 9001:2015 registered facility in Whitsett, North Carolina
about:
Cable Assembly, LLC was founded in 1988 in Whitsett, North Carolina. The company operates from a facility at 6532 Judge Adams Road and has grown into a preferred supplier for multinational customers, including numerous Fortune 500 companies.

The company specializes in wire harness and electro-mechanical assembly, offering services such as ink jet marking, hot stamping, Kanban/JIT inventory management, first article inspection, and full production runs. Engineering support includes design development from prototype to production, with capabilities spanning virtually every industry.

Cable Assembly serves industries including steam turbines, industrial equipment, HVAC equipment, fuel dispensers, point-of-sale systems, material handling equipment, construction and mining equipment, generators and air compressors, and energy management control. Its customer base includes Fortune 500 companies and multinational corporations across these sectors.

The company emphasizes its Certified LEAN Enterprise status, ISO 9001:2015 certification, UL and CSA recognition, and participation in the Tyco Electronics ACES program as key differentiators. Its reputation is built on engineering-driven responsiveness, reliability, resourcefulness, and total customer satisfaction.
